notes:
📦 Consignment: collections and other items, not just cards:
• Each line has a type: Card, Graded card, Sealed product, Collection / lot, Other item (figures, playmats, comics…)
• Collection / lot: one tag, one eBay listing, one sale — with about how many pieces and what's in it. ＋ Add a collection / lot, or tick rows → ⧉ Ticked → one lot
• Several of the same thing (e.g. 10 booster packs): tick "one listing" to sell them together, or leave it for one listing each
• From an offer, the bulk cards come over as one bulk lot instead of being left out
• Agreement, tags, payout slip, safe sheet and messages show the type, pieces and contents
